blurb: Over 70 years in the making, the Scott County Museum of History is committed to preserving the history of Scott County, Arkansas. Our museum features an extensive collection of local artifacts ranging from early Native American to Present. Included in our collection are items of special interest that are housed in our Archives Room. We also host community events, workshops, fundraisers, and special exhibit viewings.
